name: bronze_lineage
description: Where every bronze row came from, so any number can be traced back to its file and line.

columns.name: _snapshot_date
columns.description: Date of the snapshot the row was loaded from, taken from the file name.

columns.name: _source_file
columns.description: Name of the landing file the row was read from.

columns.name: _source_line
columns.description: Line the record starts on in that file; the header is line 1.

columns.name: _file_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 checksum of the whole file, proving exactly which version was loaded.
